scope: HITL-004 S5/S6 approval and tool lifecycle on exclusive disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO. Broker seeding is private test setup; owner decisions and Product-event inspection use the public StateRuntime contract. This is not a Workspace service, protected sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or browser/HTTP E2E claim.

observations.terminal_matrix: A durable pending approval was explicitly approved, explicitly denied, expired under the injected clock after runtime-store reopen, and cancelled before any grant or execution intent. The approved path then recorded the sandbox-operation finalization.
observations.product_events: The public owner projection retained safe ordered approval-resolved, approval-expired, approval-cancelled, and sandbox-operation-finalized events. Event JSON contained neither the fixture descriptor bytes nor the audit probe secret.
observations.audit_outbox: For approval, execution, cancellation, denial, and expiry, the durable matrix matched each Product-event outbox record to the exact audit fact and operation ID, in persisted event/fact/route order. Owner scope could not enumerate the separately authorized audit or outbox pages.
observations.publication_route: The closed private publisher route test verifies that every terminal approval event maps to an explicit workflow command; no new event is silently acknowledged as an unknown route.

redaction: No DSNs, object-store credentials, raw tenant/session/turn/approval/grant/operation IDs, descriptors, input bytes, artifact body, audit probe secret, backend endpoint, or provider credential are retained.
